properties.notes: Area of hardstanding that has latterly provided overflow storage space for the adjacent boatyard. No longer required and available for redevelopment. Offers a highly attractive location for new housing at Amble harbour. A higher density flatted scheme may be fitting to maximise the location and potential. Application approved for redevelopment, through construction of a block 8 apartments (15/03472/FUL). Development of 8 dwellings completed in 2018/19.
properties.site-address: Land To Rear Of The Boatyard, Coquet Street, Amble
